About these terms

These terms cover your use of this website. They don't cover HR & Payroll licenses or custom development projects — those are agreed separately, in writing, with each customer.

Using the site

You may browse the site and share its pages. Please don't try to disrupt it, get around its security, overload the contact form, or use it to send spam or unlawful content.

Accounts

The site has no user accounts. There's no public live instance of HR & Payroll here, and none of our demos should be used with real personal data.

Intellectual property

The text, design, logo and product screenshots on this site belong to Bracket Systems' developers. The product screenshots show a fictional company; names and figures in them are made up. Client names are shown with reference to work we did for them and don't imply their endorsement.

Information on this site

We work to describe our product and services accurately, and we mark features that are planned or API-only. Even so, the site is provided for information: features, editions and availability can change, and a quote or written agreement is what defines what you get. Payroll and tax rules change too; have your accountant check any configuration.

We aim to keep the site available but don't guarantee it will be uninterrupted or error-free.

The site relies on providers listed in the privacy policy and links to other sites (such as LinkedIn). We're not responsible for their content or practices.

Liability

To the extent the law allows, we're not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website. Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't be limited by law.
